00 · Start here
A growth breakdown for Bevel
Why we made this

On 29 October you shipped the update that makes Bevel faster to open and syncs training plans to Apple Calendar and Google Calendar, a month after Bevel Intelligence started building training plans with people. Apple wrote up your fall release in the App Store as "Push Harder, Recover Smarter".

This board is one idea for the next ten weeks: everyday people filming the check they already do every morning, their training and their night routines, with Bevel on screen, from Black Friday to New Year resolutions. It is free, so take whatever is useful.

How to read this board
Use the list on the left, or press P to go frame by frame. On a phone, just scroll.
Creator cards: platform, followers and median views on recent videos.
Please note
Made by hypjam from public information, checked 31 Oct 2026. Nobody at Bevel asked for this, and it is not paid work. The creators named here have not been contacted and have no link to hypjam: they show the kind of people we would cast.
12 creators shortlisted, 4 scripts with 32 hooks, and a plan to put Bevel in the morning check, the training week and the night routine, from Black Friday to the New Year.
Four numbers to remember
2.5M+: members on Bevel, from your home page (read 31 Oct)
$10M: your Series A, led by General Catalyst (October 2025)
4.8 stars: from 64.7K ratings worldwide, as your home page shows
971K: plays on one creator's "winter arc" gym video, posted on 8 September
Who made this

hypjam is a UGC agency in London. We cast, script, direct and edit creators for consumer startups, and run the best videos as ads.

01 · Why UGC
Why creator videos work
Authenticity
People trust people
Your App Store page says Bevel suggests when to train and when to rest. A runner reading her own recovery before she decides on today's run is proof.
Show, do not tell
The morning check is the demo
Bevel's moment happens every day before breakfast: Sleep, Recovery and Strain scores on one screen. A short video shows that in the first second.
Objections
Answer "what do I do with my numbers?"
Every video follows one real day: the score, the decision, the session. That answers the question better than any feature list.
A real moment
New watches arrive in December
Black Friday is 27 November, and the holidays put new watches on new wrists. Creators showing what to do with that data on day one give new owners a reason to install Bevel the same week.
Fuel for ads
Creator videos become your ads
Each creator video doubles as a partnership ad. Eight openings per script means the budget goes where viewers actually stay.
Doesn't feel like an ad
Looks like a normal morning vlog
So people watch it to the end instead of scrolling past. It is still labelled as an ad, it just does not interrupt.
02 · What we learned
Where Bevel is today
The product
Your connected health coach. Bevel turns wearable data into Sleep, Recovery and Strain scores, plus Stress, Energy Bank and Biological Age. Meals are logged by barcode, search, recipe or a short description, and Strength Builder logs every set. Bevel Intelligence answers questions from your own data, checks in on its own and builds training plans. On iPhone and Apple Watch, and it works with Garmin, Oura, Amazfit and Fitbit too.
Just shipped
27 April: Bevel 3.0, with an all-new Bevel Intelligence, Health Records and Biological Age. 13 July: the Mid-Summer Release, with Fitbit and Google Health. 30 September: training plans built with Bevel Intelligence, a new Training Calendar and a Timeline that makes food logging easier. 29 October: a faster app, and training plans that sync to your calendar.
The backing
2.5M+ members, from your home page. A $10M Series A led by General Catalyst (October 2025), after a seed round from South Park Commons and General Catalyst. 4.8 stars from 64.7K ratings worldwide. Apple featured the fall release in the App Store as "Push Harder, Recover Smarter", and 129K people follow @bevel.health on Instagram.
Already in motion
  • Release videos on X for each big update, from Bevel 3.0 in April to the faster app on 29 October.
  • On TikTok, the Bevel account (@try.bevel) posts feature demos and short explainers most days.
  • Users and ambassadors already tag @Bevel in their own TikToks.
What that tells us
People who use Bevel talk about it, and your release videos reach them. What is missing is volume: everyday people on TikTok and Reels filming their morning check, their training and their nights with Bevel on screen, every week, in front of everyone who unwraps a new watch.
The timing
Black Friday is 27 November. The holidays put new watches and rings on new wrists, and January is when people start a new routine. Videos started in November have a month to find the hooks that work.
Sources: bevel.health (home, about, and your Series A post), the US App Store listing and release notes (version 3.2.6, 29 Oct), Apple's App Store story "Push Harder, Recover Smarter", TechCrunch (30 Oct 2025), @bevel_health on X, @bevel.health on Instagram and @try.bevel on TikTok, all read 31 Oct 2026.
03 · The category
What fitness TikTok already films
Early mornings
The morning is already a genre
Creators film the hour before work, from the alarm to the gym. A "6AM productive gym morning routine" passed 1.8M plays, and one Dallas creator's early mornings before the office passed 294K to 392K each.
Night routines
Bedtime, step by step
Night routines get saved for later. One creator's "night routine that keeps me sane and able to wake up at 5am" passed 324K plays, and her 5 to 9 after the office passed 101K.
Training plans
The week, laid out
Weekly splits and sessions get saved: a footballer's weekly gym plan, posted on 6 January, passed 216K plays, and an athlete-style upper body session 166K.
Winter arc
A season with its own name
"Winter arc" is fitness TikTok's name for locking in from autumn to the New Year. One winter arc gym video passed 971K plays in September, and creators are numbering their weeks right now.
The morning score
People react to their scores
A runner's "When Garmin roasts you before breakfast" passed 130K plays. Sleep and readiness scores are something people already react to on camera.
Also in play
Wearable brands already film the morning check with athletes and runners. Your Apple Watch app, widgets and Smart Alarm were made for this feed: the score is on the wrist and the nightstand before anyone gets up.
The opening for Bevel
People already film their mornings, their training and their nights every day. What these videos rarely show is the decision in the middle: what last night's sleep and today's recovery mean for the session. That is the Bevel moment, and the videos we would start with.
Sources: public TikTok profiles and captions of about 90 morning-routine, training, running, night-routine and Apple Watch creators (TikTok search and public embeds), and bevel.health, all read 31 Oct 2026.
04 · The objection
"My watch already tracks this": the objection to win
Most people with a watch already have numbers. What they do not have is the next step. The videos should show the decision: train hard, go easy, or go to bed earlier.
What you already say
  • Make sense of your health data, from wearables to bloodwork
  • It suggests when to train, when to rest, and what is helping or hurting your progress
  • Choose your wearable, without being locked into an ecosystem
  • Answers grounded in your own metrics
  • Your data is yours, and Bevel never sells it
The watch you already wear
Bevel works with Apple Watch, Garmin, Oura, Amazfit and Fitbit, so nobody has to buy anything new to start. In a video that is one line: "I just connected the watch I already had."
One decision a day
Every script ends on an action, not a chart: the session kept or swapped, the plan for the week, the lights out earlier. Bevel is the reason, and the creator's day is the story.
How we use it
Script A opens on the morning check and ends at the gym. Script C starts the night before and ends on the next morning's sleep score. Script D asks Bevel Intelligence a real question out loud.
Keep it healthy
Scores are shown as Bevel shows them, as guidance for the day. No talk of conditions or symptoms, no weigh-ins, and no before and after.
What creators never say
Nothing about diagnosing, treating or preventing anything, which your own App Store listing rules out. No weight-loss promises. Nothing your own pages do not say Bevel does.
05 · Audience
Who to sell to first
Start here
People who film their mornings
5am and 7am routine creators who already film the alarm, the coffee and the gym. Their morning check is the product demo. Format A.
Start here
People training for a date
Runners, triathletes, footballers and lifters with a goal on the calendar. A plan built around their recovery is their whole story. Format B.
Broadest reach
Night-routine people
Everyone wants better mornings. A night routine filmed in the evening and the sleep score the next morning is a two-part video people save. Format C.
Next
New watch owners and New Year starters
People who unwrap a watch in December or start a plan in January, and want to know what to do with the numbers. Format D.
Where we would start
People who already film their mornings first. The morning check is the demo, it looks like the vlogs they already post, and every viewer with a watch on their wrist wants to see their own numbers. Training and night routines follow in December.
06 · The moment
From Black Friday to New Year resolutions
Black Friday is 27 November, the holidays put new watches on new wrists, and January is when the most people start a new routine. Videos filmed in November are tested before that rush.
Now to Black Friday (27 Nov)
6 to 8 morning-routine creators film Script A, the morning check. The first partnership ads go live on Meta and TikTok.
Thanksgiving (26 Nov) to the holidays
Night-routine creators film Script C through the busiest weeks of the year, training creators start Script B, and budget moves to the hooks that win.
January
New Year resolutions: creators ask Bevel Intelligence for a plan on camera (Script D) and film week one of it (Script B), while the best morning videos keep running as ads.
What this needs from you
  • Bevel Pro for each creator, so Bevel Intelligence and training plans are on screen
  • A tracking link per creator to the App Store
  • A short list of the features creators may show, so videos only show what ships
  • One person on your team who signs off within 48 hours
Why not wait for January?
People who unwrap a watch in December look for what to do with it that same week. Videos filmed in November are tested and cut by then, so the budget backs proven hooks, not first drafts.
07 · The first month
Your first four weeks
Week 1 · 9-15 Nov
Shortlist and formats signed off. Creators get Bevel Pro, a script with 8 hooks and at least a week of wearing their own watch with Bevel before anyone films, so every score on screen is theirs.
Week 2 · 16-22 Nov
The first morning-check videos land and we review each one within 48 hours. They get 15 and 30 second ad cuts, and hook testing begins.
Week 3 · 23-29 Nov
Thanksgiving and Black Friday week. Budget follows the openings and creators that bring installs, and night-routine creators film their first two-part videos.
Week 4 · 30 Nov-6 Dec
A results call: installs by creator and by ad, what to keep, and the plan for the holidays and New Year resolutions.
If it is a yes this week
Agreements signed and accounts out by Friday. The first videos go live within 14 days of script sign-off.
08 · Formats
Four formats for Bevel
A · Installs
My morning check
Before the coffee, the creator opens Bevel: last night's sleep, today's recovery and what Bevel suggests for the day. Then the day follows it, a hard session or an easy one. Cut into 15 and 30 second partnership ads.
a 5am morning before the office, 392K ↗Apple's story on your fall release ↗
B · Installs
Week one of my plan
A runner, triathlete, footballer or lifter asks Bevel Intelligence for a plan around a real goal, then films the week as the sessions land in the calendar, with the Muscle Map after the third workout.
a weekly gym plan posted 6 January, 216K ↗an athlete-style upper body session, 166K ↗
C · Reach
Night routine, morning score
Part one is the night routine, filmed as it happens, with habits logged and the Smart Alarm set. Part two is the next morning: the sleep score and what Bevel suggests for the day. The comments ask for part three.
a night routine for a 5am start, 324K ↗a 5 to 9 after the office, 101K ↗
D · Saves
I asked my coach
The creator asks Bevel Intelligence one real question about their own data, out loud, then shows the answer and what they changed. In January the question becomes "build me a plan for the new year".
Bevel Intelligence on your home page ↗a "winter arc" gym video, 971K ↗
In every video
1 A real person and a real day, filmed as it happens. 2 Bevel on screen in the first 5 seconds. 3 The moment the app helps: the score read out, and the decision that follows. 4 The creator's own scores, from their own watch, never staged. 5 "Ad | Paid partnership with Bevel" on screen plus the platform label.

Takeaway
Morning, training and night-routine videos travel far past their creators' follower counts. So we would run many everyday creators side by side, testing 8 hooks per script.
Where the market is
Bevel already has release videos, a TikTok that posts most days and users who tag you. Everyday creators filming their mornings, plans and nights are the next pool of faces, and the closest to the people unwrapping a new watch.
10 · Script A
Script A: My morning check
The brief

Where: TikTok and Instagram Reels from the creator's account, plus 15s and 30s Meta and TikTok partnership ads pointing at the App Store

Length: 30-35s master. 30s cut: shots 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7. 15s cut: shots 1, 2, 3 and 7 (hook, disclosure, the scores, CTA).

Goal: Installs of Bevel on iPhone

Who films it: A US creator, 18+, who already films early-morning routines (5am to 7am) and sleeps with an Apple Watch or another watch Bevel works with. They use Bevel for at least a week first, so the scores are their own. Phone on a tripod in the bedroom and kitchen, a clip from their normal gym session or run, plus a screen recording of Bevel.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. Before coffee, I check one screenBefore I even make coffee, I check one screen.
  2. My recovery decides today's workoutMy recovery decides what today's workout looks like.
  3. 5am. Sleep, recovery, strain. Let's see.5am. Sleep, recovery, strain. Let's see.
  4. Push day or easy day? I check first.Push day or easy day? I check before I get out of bed.
  5. What last night's sleep did to today's planThis is what last night's sleep did to today's plan.
  6. Recovery's in. Leg day stays.Recovery's in, so leg day stays.
  7. The 10 seconds that plan my morningThese 10 seconds plan my whole morning.
  8. Day [X] of checking before I trainDay [X] of checking my recovery before I train.

13 · Script D
Script D: I asked my coach
The brief

Where: TikTok and Instagram Reels from the creator's account, plus 15s and 30s Meta and TikTok partnership ads pointing at the App Store

Length: 30-36s master. 30s cut: shots 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7. 15s cut: shots 1, 2, 3 and 7.

Goal: Saves and installs, and Pro starts for Bevel Intelligence

Who films it: A US or UK creator, 18+, comfortable talking to camera, who has used Bevel for at least two weeks so there is real data to ask about. Filmed in one sitting, phone on a tripod, plus a screen recording of the Bevel Intelligence chat.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. "I'm feeling not rested today. What happened?"I asked Bevel why I'm not feeling rested today. Here's what it said.
  2. I asked it to build my plan for JanuaryI asked Bevel to build my plan for January.
  3. I asked my own data one questionI asked my own data one question.
  4. Should I train today? I asked.Should I train today? I asked Bevel.
  5. It checks in before I even askIt checks in on me before I even ask.
  6. 3 questions I ask my health data every weekThree questions I ask my health data every week.
  7. New watch? Ask it this first.Just got a new watch? Ask this first.
  8. It answered with my own numbersIt answered with my own numbers, not a generic tip.

Product moment and call to action

Bevel Intelligence on screen at 0:00 and Bevel named at 0:02 in the disclosure. Hero moment 0:05-0:14: the answer, grounded in the creator's own metrics, then the change it led to.

CTA: Install Bevel from the App Store ([offer as on posting day]) and ask your own question.

Caption
Ad | Paid partnership with Bevel. I asked Bevel Intelligence [your question]. [What you changed, in your words.] #ad #bevel #applewatch #newyeargoals
Rules for this video

FTC: 'Ad | Paid partnership with Bevel' on screen from 0s to the end, said out loud by 0:05, the platform's paid-partnership label switched on (TikTok content disclosure, Instagram and Facebook 'Paid partnership'), and the caption opens with the disclosure. Partnership ads run from the creator's own handle. Health: Bevel's App Store listing says it is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, monitor or prevent medical conditions, so no video does any of that: no conditions, symptoms, medicines or supplements on screen, no weight-loss or body-change promises, no weigh-ins, no before and after. Every score is the creator's own, from their own watch, shown as Bevel showed it that day; nothing is staged or edited for a better number. The app is shown exactly as it behaves on the day. Questions are about sleep, training, recovery and daily habits only: no symptoms, conditions, medicines, supplements or lab results on screen, and answers are never presented as medical advice. The answer is shown as it came. Only claims from bevel.health: answers grounded in your own metrics, proactive check-ins, sources you can check, and training plans tailored to goals and schedule. Plan and offer details exactly as on the posting day.

Why it should convert
It is the most personal part of Bevel and the easiest to film: one question, one answer, one change. In January the same video becomes "build me a plan for the new year", when everyone is looking for one.

16 · Ads
How the paid ads would run
1 · Film
Each script is shot once, with 8 different openings.
→
2 · Launch
Each opening runs as its own ad, from the creator's handle as a partnership ad.
→
3 · Read
After a few days we compare cost per install and how many people watch past 3 seconds.
4 · Cut
The weakest openings switch off and the budget moves to the best two.
→
5 · Remix
Winning hooks get new bodies and new creators.
→
6 · Refresh
New creator videos every week, so the ads never go stale.
Where the ads point
Your App Store listing, with one tracking link per creator, so every install traces back to the video that drove it.
Why partnership ads
Ads that run from a creator's own handle look like that creator's post, not a brand ad. That is the format these videos are built for.
What we would need
Each creator's OK for partnership ads, access to your Meta and TikTok ad accounts (or ad sets we run next to your team), and a weekly look at installs and Pro starts.
17 · Process
How a campaign runs, step by step
1 · Brief
You tell us the goal, the audience and what can and can't be said about Bevel.
→
2 · Cast
We shortlist creators by niche, location and median views. You pick.
→
3 · Offer
We send each creator the brief, the dates and the rate.
4 · Sign
A written agreement with every creator, covering usage and disclosure.
→
5 · Scripts
One per format: 8 hooks, a shot list, screens to record and a caption.
→
6 · Film and upload
Creators film on their phones and upload to a private folder only we see.
7 · Review
We check every video within 48 hours. Nothing posts unapproved.
→
8 · Post
On the creator's own account, with the ad disclosure and the paid-partnership label.
→
9 · Pay and report
Creators paid within 7 days of going live. You get a report every Monday.
Where creators talk to us
One hypjam Discord for every creator. Each campaign gets a private channel group for chat, scripts and posted links that only its creators and your team can see.
Accounts and real scores
Each signed creator gets Bevel Pro from you and wears their own watch with Bevel for at least a week before filming, so every score on screen is their own. We agree what each video shows before anyone records.
18 · Reporting
What we report, and when
Every video
Views, how many people stay past 3 seconds, average watch time, saves, shares and comments.
Every creator link
A tracking link for each creator, so installs trace back to the video that drove them.
Every Monday
A short report: every video, the hooks that won, installs by creator, and what we change next.
Every month
A review call: spend, installs, cost per result on anything run as an ad, and the plan for next month.
19 · Rules
Rules we never break
Disclosure
"Ad | Paid partnership with Bevel" on screen, said in the first seconds, and the platform's paid-partnership label on. That is what the FTC asks for.
Who films
Adults only (18+). Creators use Bevel themselves before they talk about it.
What gets said
Nothing your own pages do not say Bevel does. No invented numbers. We never pay for a positive opinion, only for the video.
No medical claims
Bevel is shown the way your App Store listing describes it: not a medical device, and not for diagnosing, treating, curing or preventing anything. No weight-loss promises, no talk of conditions or symptoms, and no supplements, medicines or alcohol in any video.
Real scores
Every score on screen is the creator's own, from their own watch, shown the way Bevel showed it that day. Nothing staged, edited or recreated for a better number.
How we run it
Every video reviewed within 48 hours before it posts. Creators paid within 7 days of going live.
